Is the FAA's proposal under docket FAA-2012-0805 to rescind the existing AD on Boeing 767 fuel tank motor operated valve actuators still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: It is no longer active. The FAA published an NPRM on 2012-07-31 proposing to rescind the existing AD for Boeing 767-200, -300, -300F and -400ER airplanes (the fuel tank MOV actuator inspection AD). On 2013-06-13 the FAA withdrew that NPRM, so the rescission was not adopted and the existing AD remains in effect. No comment deadline remains open.

query: Is the proposed AD under docket FAA-2012-0962 for the Cessna 172RG, R182, 210 and T303 landing gear hydraulic power pack wiring inspection still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The NPRM issued 2012-09-05 would have required inspection of the hydraulic power pack wiring for incorrect installation. The FAA withdrew it in a document issued 2013-01-14, so no AD will be issued from that proposal.

query: For the Airbus A330/A340 proposed AD under docket FAA-2026-1338 that would supersede ADs 2014-16-22, 2017-25-13 and 2024-25-11, is the original February 2026 proposal still the current version, or has it been revised?
gold_status: The original NPRM (2026-03747, issued 2026-02-20) is no longer the latest version. It was revised by a later notice (2026-20543, issued 2026-10-05), which revises the NPRM to supersede ADs 2014-16-22, 2017-25-13 and 2024-25-11. The proposal has not been withdrawn; the revised NPRM is the current version.

query: What is the current status of the FAA proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2011-0449 that would have required a Rotorcraft Flight Manual limitation for Bell 206A/206B/206B3 helicopters with litter kits installed? Is it still open for comment or was it withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. It was withdrawn by the FAA in a notice (document 2021-04508) issued 2021-02-26, which withdrew the NPRM originally issued 2011-01-31. No AD was adopted from it and there is no open comment deadline.

query: Is the 2007 proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2007-27495, which would require modifying the collective hold-down strap on certain Eurocopter France (now Airbus Helicopters) AS350, EC-130B4 and AS355 helicopters, still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The NPRM published 2007-02-26 would have required modifying the collective hold-down strap and inspecting it at intervals. The FAA withdrew it in a notice (document 2021-04235) issued 2021-02-24, so no AD will result from this proposal.

query: What is the current status of the FAA proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2022-1401 covering GE CF6-80E1 series turbofan engines with suspect compressor discharge pressure seals and forward outer seals? Is it still open for comment or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The FAA withdrew the NPRM on 2023-06-08 (document 2023-12695), so no final AD will be issued from it and there is no open comment deadline.
